dcat_keyword_sm: Osoyoos Division of Yale Land District
dct_creator_sm: Jemmett, William Sugden (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Inset map of Reserve No. 2 where the Okanagan River meets Dog Lake was not georeferenced.

Georeferenced map of Osoyoos Band Osoyoos 1 reserve from Oliver to Osoyoos. Land cover and features described on the map includes posts, village, cultivated areas, trails, grain fields, springs, and the types of land, soil, and timber.
